cause: Pydantic validation context contained a ValueError that runner V1 attempted to serialize after receiving the provider response.
evidence_policy: The run is retained but excluded from paper metrics because the failed cell response was not persisted and a cell-only retry would violate the frozen no-content-retry rule.
corrective_actions: Remove non-JSON exception context from public validator diagnostics.
Persist every provider response atomically before processing untrusted content.
Start a complete new 120-cell run after committing the fix.
